title: A Message from Lviv
text:
Hi Tom, how are you? I am writing from Lviv. The weather is hot and the city is beautiful. I have a new friend here, Olena.

We visit museums every day. Yesterday we ate ice cream in a big park. Please write to me soon and tell me your news!

questions.text: What did the writer and the friends do yesterday?
options: They ate ice cream in a park.
They went swimming in the sea.

questions.text: How does the writer feel about the city?
What does the writer probably want Tom to do?

vocabulary.definition: buildings where interesting objects are shown to the public
information about recent events or about someone's life
a person you know well and like a lot

paragraph_translations: Привіт, Томе, як справи? Я пишу з Львова. Погода гаряча, а місто дуже гарне. Тут у мене є новий друг, Олена.
Щодня ми відвідуємо музеї. Учора ми їли морозиво у великому парку. Будь ласка, напиши мені скоро і розкажи свої новини!
